freeze_note: G4 diffusion outcomes already observed for pipeline validation; efficacy baseline samples and comparisons not yet evaluated. This is a staged exploratory toy screen, not an independent confirmatory preregistration.
limits: Toy efficacy screening at model seed0; no population pooling or multi-seed efficacy claim. G6 would independently require model seeds0/1/2.
pass_criterion: At K100, diffusion exceeds both source_prior and uniform_random with CI lower>0 and Holm p<.05. Otherwise FAIL if source-prior delta CI upper<0; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. G6 cannot run unless PASS.
setting: G4 frozen MD5 q8 ABCD^4 toy; exactly same 18 targets and saved seed0 candidates
source_prior: iid uniform A/B/C/D at each of four positions; no target or length inputs. Distribution exactly equals uniform enumeration baseline; independent RNG realizations.
statistics: Paired target outcomes; one-sided exact McNemar; target-level percentile bootstrap95; Holm family all 7 diffusion-vs-baseline comparisons across K.
validity: Same codec+ABCD^4 domain validity as G4. Invalid, duplicates and malformed candidates consume K. No replacement.
